paper_title: Millimeter-wave WISP search with coherent Light-Shining-Through-a-Wall towards the STAX project
notes: LSW (light-shining-through-wall) projection for dark photon kinetic mixing in mass range 1e-4 to 1e-3 eV. This is a proposal/projection paper. The only explicit numerical sensitivity given in text is Stage A low-power reaching chi ~ 1e-8 around m_gamma' ~ 1e-4 eV (Eq. 16 context). Detailed exclusion curves (Stages A, B, C) are shown only in Figures 6 and 7 with no tabulated values, so precise data points cannot be reliably extracted. The two-point line encodes the stated Stage A sensitivity chi~1e-8 across the target mass range as an approximation.
